question: As per Sample Registration System (SRS) 2020, which of the following Indian states had the highest natural growth rate in population?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Sample Registration System (SRS) 2020**, **Bihar** had the **highest natural growth rate** in population among Indian states.
 
• The **natural growth rate** is calculated as the difference between the **crude birth rate (CBR)** and the **crude death rate (CDR)**.
 
• **Bihar** consistently reports one of the **highest birth rates** in India, contributing significantly to its high natural growth rate.
 
• The state has a **young population**, which leads to a higher rate of births compared to deaths.
 
• Despite efforts to promote **family planning** and reduce fertility rates, the state’s **socio-economic factors** and cultural practices influence its population growth.
 
• Bihar's high population growth presents challenges related to **infrastructure, healthcare, and education**, but also provides a large **workforce** for the state and nation.
 
• The high growth rate is a key factor in discussions around **population policies** and sustainable development in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has a high population and is the most populous state in India, but its **natural growth rate** is slightly lower than Bihar’s.
 
• The state is actively working on reducing its **fertility rate** through various government programs.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** also contributes significantly to India's population but has a relatively **lower birth rate** compared to Bihar.
 
• The state is focusing on improving its **health infrastructure** to address population-related challenges.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 
 
• **Rajasthan** has a geographically large area but a **moderate population density** compared to Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The state has been implementing measures to control **population growth** by improving **education and awareness**.
